question: Which of the following was the capital of Vajji Mahajanapada?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaishali.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vaishali **was the capital of **Vajji Mahajanapada.**
 
• It was an important city and a center of** trade and commerce.**
 
• Vajji Mahajanapada was one of the important **Mahajanapadas** in ancient India.
 
• It was located in the** present-day Bihar region.**
 
• It was known for its **republican form of government** and had a strong army.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gaya **was another important city in **Bihar**.
 
• **Anga** was a neighboring **Mahajanapada **of Vajji Mahajanapada, but it was not its capital.
 
• **Pataliputra **was the capital of **Magadha Mahajanapada,** which was another powerful Mahajanapada in ancient India.
